items.t: Manchester United plc Announces Departure of Men's First Team Head Coach Michael Carrick After Winning 12 Out of 17 Games in 2025/26
Manchester United plc - Club Statement on Michael Carrick
items.sum: MANCHESTER, England, November 12, 2026--Manchester United plc (NYSE: MANU), can confirm that Michael Carrick has departed his role as men’s first team head coach.

items.t: Manchester United plc Announces First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Earnings Report Date
items.sum: MANCHESTER, England, November 10, 2026--Manchester United plc (NYSE: MANU), announces that it will report results for the first quarter fiscal 2027 period ended 30 September 2026 via press release on 19 November 2026 at 7:00 AM EST.

items.t: Manchester United (MANU) Stock Could Be 14% Overvalued On Relegation Warning
